reply.description: Every expert the account has written, one per book, in no particular order; a book without one has no entry. An expert whose book is gone may still be listed: the views join with books: list.

id.description: The id of the book the expert is on; one expert per book.

prompt.description: What the user wrote for the expert: how it talks and what it knows. It joins the start of a new chat that picks it.

on.description: Whether it shows on the shelf above a new chat; only one with a prompt is on.
